**Rationale:** We have only the D1 entrance checkpoint. The first priority is to establish a checkpoint lineage — the player must descend and save at every new depth so the archive grows. The survival prohibition targets the most common preventable early death: staying in combat at low HP. The wiki says "if [HP] goes below half of its maximum, run away to heal," so this directive steers the player toward that habit while giving it a concrete descent goal. "Do not fight while HP is below half" is an outcome check (game state HP vs maxHP at the moment of any attack action), not a tool ban, and it's paired with the positive action of finding stairs, descending, and saving.
